properties.name: Noah Enters the Ark
properties.description: Noah, his family, and the animals entered the ark. God shut them in 7 days before the Flood began.
properties.debate: The ark held 8 people and representatives of all land animal 'kinds' - far fewer than modern species.

properties.name: Fountains of the Great Deep
properties.description: All the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the windows of heaven opened. This was a global cataclysm.
properties.debate: Some creation geologists propose massive underground water chambers released during rapid continental drift.

properties.name: Windows of Heaven
properties.description: Rain fell for 40 days and 40 nights. Some propose a pre-Flood vapor canopy collapsed.
properties.debate: The 'windows of heaven' may refer to a pre-Flood atmospheric water source now absent.

properties.name: Highest Mountains Covered
properties.description: Waters rose 15 cubits above the highest mountains. All flesh with the breath of life perished.
properties.archaeology: Marine fossils found on every continent's mountains, including the Himalayas, support a global flood.

properties.name: 150 Days of Flooding
properties.description: Waters prevailed on the earth 150 days. Only those on the ark survived.
